kappa.description: Formal odd central nilpotent parameter (kappa^2 = 0) parametrizing the inhomogeneous deformation

K.description: Even central element associated with canonical identity scalar in oscillator algebra

fermions.description: Standard fermionic oscillator pair a_1^± satisfying canonical anticommutation relations (CAR)

bosons.description: Bosonic oscillators b_k^± with k=1,...,2 satisfying CCR

standard_fermion_anticommutators.description: Canonical anticommutation relations (CAR) for fermionic oscillators

bosonic_commutators.description: Canonical commutation relations (CCR) for bosonic oscillators

mixed_commutators.boson_fermion: [b_k^±, a_1^σ] = 0 for all k and σ in {+,-}

references: Frappat et al. (2000), Dictionary on Lie Algebras and Superalgebras
